normal_result_sets: SELECT matching-row count equals deleted_count; before_count=8 and after_count=8-deleted_count. Valid normal alternatives include both matching/deleted=0; do not force DELETE=1.
basis: The original report asks consistency of SELECT and DELETE, not proof which side is correct. The frozen script projects HEX(val) to avoid control bytes.
allowed_warning_note: BIT/string range or conversion warnings retained; cannot alone establish a bug.
phase_rule: Execute original SQL unchanged and in order, then separately captured read-only validation SQL; validation is required before classification.
on_sql_error: These selected reports target wrong results, not SQL errors; unexpected SQL errors mean execution_failed, never automatically reproduced.
on_other_pattern: other_anomaly; do not attribute an unexpected pattern to the report
